theorems.name: Submission.dohr_tp_gat_bilip_measure_comparison
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (A : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (Φ : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (δ : ℝ), MeasurableSet A → 0 ≤ δ → δ < 1 → (∀ p ∈ A, ∀ q ∈ A, ‖Φ p - Φ q - (p - q)‖ ≤ δ * ‖p - q‖) → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).restrict (Φ '' A) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (((1 - δ)⁻¹) ^ n) • Measure.map Φ ((μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).restrict A) ∧ Measure.map Φ ((μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).restrict A) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (((1 - δ)⁻¹) ^ n) • (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).restrict (Φ '' A)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
